sharedPromptText.hood:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: runtime 2D clothing overlay for Rosie, a front-facing chibi pig game character
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and exact hood geometry template; Image 2 is a fit-only character reference and must NOT appear in output.
Primary request: Restyle only the clothing material and decoration of Image 1 into THEME.
Style/medium: polished soft-painted mobile-game costume art, tactile fabric, cocoa-brown outline treatment matching Image 1.
Composition/framing: preserve Image 1 pixel dimensions, exact placement, scale, padding, silhouette, and overlay alignment. The hood must remain a wide low garment with exactly one large central face window and exactly two original pig-ear holes.
Critical transparency: keep the entire exterior background genuinely transparent. Keep the face window and both ear holes genuinely transparent alpha. No pig skin, eyes, snout, ears, feet, character, or body baked into the clothing.
Constraints: preserve the face-hole edge geometry, both ear-hole edge geometries, and all outer padding exactly. No tall human hood, no human body, no arms, no boots, no extra legs. No text, watermark, checkerboard, white backdrop, brown smoke, exterior glow, drop-shadow halo, or scenery.
sharedPromptText.romper:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: runtime 2D clothing overlay for Rosie, a front-facing chibi pig game character
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and exact romper geometry template; Image 2 is a fit-only character reference and must NOT appear in output.
Primary request: Restyle only the clothing material and decoration of Image 1 into THEME.
Style/medium: polished soft-painted mobile-game costume art, tactile fabric, cocoa-brown outline treatment matching Image 1.
Composition/framing: preserve Image 1 pixel dimensions, exact placement, scale, padding, compact silhouette, and overlay alignment. The romper must remain a short low garment with exactly three hoof openings at the bottom.
Critical transparency: keep the entire exterior background genuinely transparent. Keep all three hoof holes genuinely transparent alpha. No pig skin, eyes, snout, ears, hooves, feet, character, or body baked into the clothing.
Constraints: preserve all three hoof-hole edge geometries and outer padding exactly. No tall human torso, no human body, no arms, no sleeves, no boots, no extra legs, no tail. No text, watermark, checkerboard, white backdrop, brown smoke, exterior glow, drop-shadow halo, or scenery.

exactPromptAssembly: For each asset, the exact submitted prompt is the corresponding sharedPromptText string with the single literal token THEME replaced by that asset's themeText, with no other changes.
